strings: A square piece of iron standing on four metal legs. It can not move.
A poster instructing the viewer to obey authority.
A very simple first aid kit meant to secure and stabilize serious wounds for later treatment.
Has a valve and pump attached to it.
Come on Lady Luck, spawn me a pair of sunglasses.
A little bit of nature contained in a pot.
A great place for storing knowledge.
A trusty station intercom, ready to spring into action even when the headsets go silent.
A flexible, superconducting insulated cable for heavy-duty power transfer.
Lead-lined shutters with a radiation hazard symbol. Whilst this won't stop you getting irradiated, especially by a supermatter crystal, it will stop radiation travelling as far.
This machine is used to process large quantities of information.
A one meter section of regular pipe.
The HS-452. Installed in the 2550s by the Nanotrasen Hygiene Division, now with 2560 lead compliance! Passively replenishes itself with water when not in use.
Drainage inlet embedded in the floor to prevent flooding.
Flooring that shows its contents underneath. Engineers love it!
You sit in this. Either by will or force.
A huge chunk of iron used to separate rooms.
A pump that moves gas by pressure.
It's a storage unit for tools.
Goggles used by engineers. The Meson Scanner mode lets you see basic structural and terrain layouts through walls and the T-ray Scanner mode lets you see underfloor objects such as cables and pipes.
Basic railing meant to protect idiots like you from falling.
Emergency air-tight shutter, capable of sealing off breached areas. This one has a glass panel. It has a mechanism to open it with just your hands.
Used to treat toxic blood content and radiation poisoning.
A first aid kit with the ability to heal common types of injuries.
This informational poster uses Safety Moth™ to inform the viewer to help injured/deceased crewmen with their epinephrine injectors. \"Prevent organ rot with this one simple trick!\"
A standard metal table frame covered with an amazingly fancy, patterned cloth.
Soft velvet carpeting. Feels good between your toes.
These seeds grow into coffee arabica bushes.
These seeds grow into coffee robusta bushes.
It has a picture of drinking glasses on it.
Contains pills used as a last resort means to temporarily stabilize depression and anxiety. WARNING: side effects may include slurred speech, drooling, and severe addiction.
Pull this in case of emergency. Thus, keep pulling it forever.
A huge chunk of reinforced metal used to separate rooms.
A handheld scanner used for completing the many experiments of modern science.
A small wall mounted cabinet designed to hold a fire extinguisher.
A large cart for hauling around large amounts of laundry.
It's seriously hampering your view of the jungle.
You can't tell if this is real grass or just cheap plastic imitation.
The lynchpin of a GOOD transit system.
A window that is reinforced with metal rods.
A machine, somewhat akin to a lathe, made specifically for manufacturing ammunition. It has a slot for magazines, ammo boxes, clips... anything that holds ammo.
A control terminal for the area's electrical systems.
Contains all the paper you'll never need.
It's a normal black ink pen.
The banner of the eternal Cargonia, with the mystical power of conjuring any object into existence.
A machine used to deposit and withdraw station funds.
A sign that warns of extremely hot air in the vicinity.
Different from the Middle Ages version.

A lovely little box filled with soft, cute plushies, perfect for calming down people who have just suffered a traumatic event. Legend has it there's a special part of hell 	for Medical Officers who just take the box for themselves.
Made by Space Amish using traditional space techniques, this heater/cooler is guaranteed not to set the station on fire. Warranty void if used in engines.
A solar panel. Generates electricity when in contact with sunlight.
A basin used to grow plants in.
From here you can research mysteries of the DNA!
Used to keep bodies in until someone fetches them. Includes a high-tech alert system.
span_alert("Keep out of reach of children.")
A pair of gloves, they don't look special in any way.
A machine that monitors atmosphere levels. Goes off if the area is dangerous.
They look like human remains. They have a strange aura about them.
Some type of shrubbery. Known for causing considerable economic stress on designers.
A large piece of space-resistant printed paper.
A radio beacon used for bot navigation.
A stationary computer. This one comes preloaded with generic programs.

An industrial unit made to hold, charge, and decontaminate equipment. It comes with a built-in UV cauterization mechanism. A small warning label advises that organic matter should not be placed into the unit.
It's a floor-mounted device for projecting holographic images.
A small crowbar. This handy tool is useful for lots of things, such as prying floor tiles or opening unpowered doors.
A wrench with common uses. Can be found in your hand.
Helping lost spacemen find their way through the planets since 2016.
This cone is trying to warn you of something!
A sink used for washing one's hands and face. Passively reclaims water over time.
A portable generator for emergency backup power.
A lightbulb you can walk on without breaking it, amazing.
Heavy duty, airtight, plastic flaps. Definitely can't get past those. No way.
A trash bin, place your trash here for the janitor to collect.
A vending machine is guaranteed to spawn here, but its exact model is not known. The normal atlas view shows one possible outcome; the actual machine is chosen when the round starts.
A small screen which the AI can use to present itself.
Suited for Cyborgs and Humanoids, the pod is a safe place for personnel affected by the Space Sleep Disorder to get some rest.
It's slippery and gooey. Perhaps it's the chef's cooking?
A reinforced version of the four legged table.
A display case with an ID-card swiper. Use your ID to purchase the contents.
A charging dock for energy based weaponry, PDAs, and other devices.
A huge chunk of metal with a dial embedded in it. Fine print on the dial reads \"Scarborough Arms - 2 tumbler safe, guaranteed thermite resistant, explosion resistant, and assistant resistant.\"

An injector with a cocktail of nanomachines and chemicals, this device can seemingly raise animals from the dead, making them become friendly to the user. Unfortunately, the process is useless on higher forms of life and incredibly costly, so these were hidden in storage until an executive thought they'd be great motivation for some of their employees.
This informational sign uses HoP Moth™ reminding the viewer to do their part in the station's Enterprise Resource Planning efforts, punching out before periods of prolonged absence or leisure time.
Perfectly designed to be comfortable to sit on, and hellish to sleep on.
A heavy duty blast door that opens mechanically.
A covered turret that shoots at its enemies.
A sign with the Nanotrasen logo on it. Glory to Nanotrasen!
You feel a strange nostalgia from looking at this...
Only for the finest of art!
Draw out your soul on this canvas!
It's a storage unit for fire-fighting supplies.
A machine that cools and dispenses liquids to drink. The 'hot' handle doesn't seem to do anything.
A poster encouraging you to help fellow crewmembers.
Contains all the paper you'll ever need, in duplicate!
A rubber stamp for stamping important documents.
Heats or cools gas in connected pipes.
A tank full of industrial welding fuel. Do not consume.
A luxurious double bed, for those too important for small dreams.
It is decorated with a wrench emblem. It's highly reflective and stain resistant, so you don't need to worry about ruining it with oil.
A slightly larger welder with a larger tank.
A head-mounted face cover designed to protect the wearer completely from space-arc eye.
A stationary computer. This one comes preloaded with identification modification programs.
A coil of insulated power cable.
A canister for the storage of gas.
A wall with rough iron plating.
A heap of dense garbage. Perhaps there is something interesting inside?
This port recharges a mech's internal power cell.

A link to the netverse. It has an assortment of cables to connect yourself to a virtual domain.
Experimental trenchcoat specially crafted to reflect and absorb laser and disabler shots. Don't expect it to do all that much against an axe or a shotgun, however.
A weapon that can only be used to its full potential by the truly robust.
The input side of a turbine generator, contains the compressor.
A shield generator meant for use in xenobiology.
A complex metal backbone with standard limb sockets and pseudomuscle anchors.
A figurine depicting that silent bastard you are all too familiar with.
Used to view crew member accounts and purchases.
Traditional burial garments from the early 22nd century.

A stylish vendor to dispense the most stylish bar clothing!
A figurine depicting a Bartender looking stylish with their rockin shades and tophat.
Human friendly interface to the mysterious gate next to it.
A machine with a centrifuge installed into it. It produces smoke with any reagents you put into the machine.
Used to call and send the lavaland shuttle.
A figurine depicting a Chaplain hopefully praying for good things.
Used to monitor the crew's PDA messages, as well as request console messages.
A case of imported Cohiba cigars, renowned for their strong flavor.
A volcanic rock. Pioneers used to ride these babies for miles.
A low-stock vendor only capable of vending clothing for curators and librarians.
A figurine depicting the one-and-only Curator.
A vending machine designed to dispense clothing and tools for roboticists.
A figurine depicting a mothic Roboticist donning a labcoat.
A robust flashlight used by security.

An advanced machine equipped with state of the art bomb prediction software that's capable of implosion-compressing raw anomaly cores into finished artifacts. 	Comes with a built-in stabilization and sound-supressant field that consumes a lot of power to prevent obnoxious shaking and sounds heard station-wide, as not to wake up any dorms users.
A set of curtains serving as a fancy theater backdrop. They can only be opened by a button.
Used for repairing or building APCs.
A much larger version of the hand-held scanner. A charred label warns about its destructive capabilities.
A machine that automatically stacks acquired materials. Controlled by a nearby console.
For masterpieces hand-picked by the curator.
MEGA presents the new Xenos Isolated action figure! Comes complete with realistic sounds! Pull back string to use.
A camera film cartridge. Insert it into a camera to reload it.

Contains pills used to treat brain damage.
Contains pills to treat non-severe mental traumas.

A S.U.N.S.H.I.N.E. brand water tank backpack with a nozzle to water plants.
A booklet containing paper soaked in universal indicator.
A refrigerated storage unit for organ storage.
Spare tool vending. What? Did you expect some witty description?
Someone must have sent this a long way.
This plaque commemorates the fall of the Atmos FEA division. For all the charred, dizzy, and brittle men who have died in its hands.
A crafting bench fitted with tools, securing mechanisms, and a steady surface for blacksmithing.
A machine that processes and routes PDA and request console messages.
It's a storage unit for laser tag equipment.
All the colors of the bloody murder rainbow.
A basin meant to quench heated smithing equipment and cool it.
A vending machine renowned for vending industrial grade clothing.
A figurine depicting the glorious head of the Security department.
Use this if your friends left you behind.
A Modello 3 Coffeemaker that brews coffee and holds it at the perfect temperature of 176 fahrenheit. Made by Piccionaia Home Appliances.
Used to send criminals to the Labor Camp.
A mask made of soft vinyl and latex, representing the head of a jackal.
Standard Security gear. Protects the head from impacts.
BLAM!-brand foaming space cleaner. In a special applicator for rapid cleaning of wide areas.
A toolbox painted bright green. Why anyone would store art supplies in a toolbox is beyond you, but it has plenty of extra space.
A crystal made from pure glass used to transmit laser databursts to subspace.
For when it all gets too much to bear. Do not taunt.
A figurine depicting someone in a blood-red modsuit, similar to what someone on a nuclear operative team might wear.
A telescreen that connects to the AI upload's camera network.
This is a minimoog, like a space piano, but more spacey!
A sign labelling an area containing pharmacy equipment.
Important notices from the heads of staff.
A poster warning of the dangers of poor hygiene.
This is the adorable by-product of multiple attempts at genetically mixing mothpeople with cockroaches.
It's a sick-looking goose, probably ate too much maintenance trash. Best not to move it around too much.
A warning sign which reads 'KEEP CLEAR OF DOCKING AREA'.
A reprint of a poster from 2505, commemorating the 50th Anniversary of Nanoposters Manufacturing, a subsidiary of Nanotrasen.
Looks like a knock-off chem-master. Perhaps useful for separating liquids when mixing drinks precisely. Also dispenses condiments.
Enlist in the Nanotrasen Deathsquadron reserves today!
A camera that can be used to display whomever is in front of it across all status displays. 		Pair with a greenscreen for best results.
An altar which allows the head of the church to choose a sect of religious teachings as well as provide sacrifices to earn favor.
A glass lab container for storing interesting creatures.
A deluxe Waffle Corporation brand bar of soap. Smells of high-class luxury.
A tiny laser used in certain devices. A lil left.
I hope I get one that actually matches my meal.
A simple bowl, used for soups and salads.
Just be careful your food doesn't melt the spoon first.
A cheap metal tray to pile today's meal onto.
Jeez. I hope that's not for lunch.
A suit that helps protect against fire and heat.
A manifold composed of regular pipes.
Turn your Good Assistant Points punchcards in here for a payout based on the amount of punches you have, and get a new card!
A defunct genetics machine for merging foreign DNA with a subject's own.
A wooden musical instrument with four strings and a bow. \"The devil went down to space, he was looking for an assistant to grief.\"
These clunky gauntlets allow you to drag things with more confidence on them not getting nabbed from you.
An industrial computer integrated with a camera-assisted rapid construction drone.
Goes great with a glass of warm milk.
A cheap bar of soap. Doesn't smell.
By inserting components and a cell into this, wiring them up, and putting them into a shell, anyone can pretend to be a programmer.
A compact micro-machine capable of stretching out hyper-compressed radio waves.
A figurine depicting the glorious head of the Cargo department.
A comfy-looking cat bed. You can even strap your pet in, in case the gravity turns off.
Headset used by the service staff, tasked with keeping the station full, happy and clean.
It has a Nanotrasen symbol on it, and was woven with a revolutionary new kind of thread guaranteed to have 0.01% permeability for most non-chemical substances, popular among most modern captains.
Accepts boulders and refines non-metallic ores into sheets using internal chemicals.
A large duffel bag for holding extra things. There is a Nanotrasen logo on the back.
A silver card which shows honour and dedication.
A gold plated Desert Eagle folded over a million times by superior martian gunsmiths. Uses .50 AE ammo.
Allows you to purify reagents & separate out inverse reagents
It's Officer Pingsky! Delegated to satellite guard duty for harbouring anti-human sentiment.
A box containing a compactly packed machine. Use multitool to deploy.
These gloves are supposed to be a random color...
A pain reliever. Does minor liver damage. Diluted with Granibitaluri.
Helps with burn injuries. Does minor eye damage. Diluted with Granibitaluri.
An AI Module for programming laws to an AI.
Old will forever be in fashion.
A wooden board with letters etched into it, used in seances.
The flag of the Terran Government, home of humanity.
Essentially a big block of metal that you can hammer other metals on top of, crucial for anyone working metal by hand.
Only intended for binding paper products.

You can drill using this item. You dig?
A wall mounted safe containing space suits. Will only open in emergencies.
A folder stamped \"Top Secret - Property of Nanotrasen Corporation. Unauthorized distribution is punishable by death.\"

It is made out of the same material as the station's Black Box and is designed to resist all conventional weaponry. 		There appears to be a small amount of surface corrosion. It doesn't look like it could withstand much of an explosion.		Due to the expensive material, it was made incredibly small to cut corners, leaving only enough room to fit something as slim as an ID card.

Sheriff Blasto's here to take back Laundry County from the evil Johnny Dirt and the Clothstain Crew, and he's brought a posse. It's High Noon for Tough Stains: Blasto brand detergent, available at all good stores.
A figurine depicting an every day, run-of-the-mill assistant. No funny business here.
A sign that warns of high-power testing equipment in the area.
A mysterious gateway built by unknown hands, it allows for faster than light travel to far-flung locations.
Accept boulders and refines metallic ores into sheets.
Ordnance for Dummies or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Maxcap
A heavily reinforced case containing cyborg logic boards, with space for a standard power cell.
A short engineering holographic barrier used for designating hazardous zones, slightly blocks radiation. Can only be passed by walking.
A small bottle of toxins. Do not drink, it is poisonous.
A very complex router and transmitter capable of connecting electronic devices together. Looks fragile.
An adorable stuffed toy of a SecHound, the trusty Nanotrasen sponsored security borg!
A poster condemning the station's security forces.
A long list of rules to be followed when in the library, extolling the virtues of being quiet at all times and threatening those who would dare eat hot food inside.
A large crushing machine used to recycle small items inefficiently. There are lights on the side.
A modified verison of the dish drive, for security. Because they're lazy.
A sign labelling an area where the law is law.
One of the Nomad Fleet's own ration vendors; in spite of the name engraved into it, it's been fitted to accept credits.
A hardlight gate with an ID scanner attached to the side. Good at deterring even the most persistent temporarily embarrassed employee.
A machine for dispensing clothing related to genetics.
A figurine depicting a reptillian Geneticist donning a labcoat, staring at you with evil intent.
It's Officer Beepsky! Powered by a potato and a shot of whiskey, and with a sturdier reinforced chassis, too.
A Type-II-AD-P armored vest that provides decent protection against most types of damage.
For gamers only. Casuals need not apply.
As seen in your favourite Japanese cartoon.
Looks like someone threw it out. Covered in donut crumbs.

A structure built out of bricks, for heating up metal, or glass, or ceramic, or food, or anything really.
It's milk. White and nutritious goodness!
It's soy milk. White and nutritious goodness!
Careful, cold ice, do not chew.
A colorful butterfly, how'd it get up here?
Learn how our ancestors got to Orion, and have fun in the process!

A candle with low melting temperature.
A display case for prized possessions.

Ding-aling ding dong. Get your Nanotrasen-approved ice cream!
All the class of a trenchcoat without the security fibers.
A tacky suit perfect for a CRIMINAL lawyer!

A figurine depicting a reptillian Prisoner with a scar.
Deploy to designate the landing zone of the auxiliary base.

A headset allowing the wearer to communicate with medbay and service.
This poster reminds the crew that Enterprise Resource Planning is not allowed by company policy, in accordance with Spinward governmental regulations on megacorporations.
A direction sign, pointing out which way the station's AI Upload is.
A compressed fuel pellet for long-distance drone flight.
Tastes just like the chef's soup.
It allows quick identification of trained medical personnel.
This is the ship we're on. It's amazing what Nanotrasen can do once they actually put more than ten seconds of effort into their projects.
A figurine depicting a mothic Psychologist donning a monocle.
A sophisticated analyzer capable of analyzing cryptic subspace wavelengths.
Used for playing the most violent and degrading of childhood games.

The Owl would do his best to protect the station. Will you?

An automated announcement system that handles minor announcements over the radio.
A machine that accepts ore and instantly transforms it into workable material sheets. Points for ore are generated based on type and can be redeemed at a mining equipment vendor.
It would seem it vends dyes, and other stuff to make you pretty.
A locked box used to store medals of honor.
Being fancy can be for any borg, just need a suit.

Dispenses pipes that will ultimately be used to move trash around.

A massive module rack which can hold many modules including a core law module. 		It can even be linked to other module racks to add additional slots. 		Designed to be used by the station's primary AI and its legion of cyborgs.
A refrigerated storage unit for volatile sample storage.
A copy of the first run of Captain's Aid ever released. Functionally the same as the later batches, just more expensive. For the truly aristocratic.
Maybe hugging this will make you feel better about yourself.
A not so ferocious, fang bearing creature that resembles a shark. This one seems a little big for its tank.
A simple microscope, allowing you to examine micro-organisms.
Used to retrieve cell lines from organisms. Don't worry, it won't sting.
A modified version of the Type 5/R laser carbine. Fires entirely harmless bolts of directed energy. Safe AND entertaining to fire with abandon.
A case of premium cigars. Very expensive.
A case of classy Havanian cigars.
A special protolathe with a built in interface meant for departmental usage, with built in ExoSync receivers allowing it to print designs researched that match its ROM-encoded department type.
A handheld tracking device that locks onto certain signals.
A secure crate containing various materials for building a customised test-site.
A shooting target that looks like a xenomorphic alien.
A shooting target that looks like a useless clown.
A guidance sign which reads 'Exam Room'.
You did good in the worst way possible.

Not known for their pleasant disposition.

A device which produces a graviton field when set up.
A large piece of equipment used to open a window into the subspace dimension.
Central Command standard issue inspection device. 		Used for precision scans to determine if an item contains, or is itself, contraband.
Processing food before electricity was cool, because you can just do your regular cutting on the table next to this right?
An adorable stuffed toy that resembles a slime. It is practically just a hacky sack.
A metal frame for building a scooter. Looks like you'll need to add some iron to make wheels.
A tiny device capable of filtering and converting super-intense radio waves.
WARNING: These devices are extremely dangerous and can cause blindness and skin irritation.
A box full of standard firing pins, to allow newly-developed firearms to operate.
A computer designed to handle the calculations and routing required for sending and receiving mechs from orbit. Requires a link to a nearby Orbital Mech Pad to function.
It is decorated with a shield emblem. While crime doesn't sleep, you do, but you are still THE LAW!
A blue letterman jacket with a proud Nanotrasen N on the back. The tag says that it was made in Space China.
A pair of kitty ears. Meow!
A light-weight titanium wall used in shuttles.
An engine that releases a large bluespace burst to propel it.
A comfortable, secure seat. It has a more sturdy looking buckling system, for smoother flights.
